news.headline: Sources: Raiders not planning on trading Maxx Crosby, who wants to stay
news.description: The Raiders do not plan on trading Maxx Crosby, who wants to stay in Las Vegas, sources told ESPN.

news.headline: Sources: Bears, Titans used Myles Garrett deal as framework for Simmons trade
news.description: The Bears and Titans came up with a Jeffery Simmons proposal that was based off this year's Myles Garrett trade, sources told ESPN.

news.headline: Sources: Saquon Barkley won't be traded by deadline despite Eagles' struggles
news.description: Saquon Barkley will not be traded before the trade deadline, sources told NFL Network, putting an end to speculation that the Eagles RB could be on the move.

news.headline: Sources: Colts willing to trade RB Jonathan Taylor, active in talks with teams

news.headline: Derwin James placed on injured reserve after hamstring rehab setback

news.headline: Fantasy football last-minute pickups: Geno Smith, Ryan Flournoy are top options

news.headline: Patriots rule out A.J. Brown, TreVeyon Henderson vs. Dolphins
news.description: Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Dolphins. In addition, No. 2 running back TreVeyon Henderson has been ruled out due to an illness.

news.headline: NFL to review additional allegations against Packers RB Josh Jacobs
news.description: The NFL said it will look into additional allegations of physical and verbal abuse by Packers RB Josh Jacobs that were revealed as part of a public records release from the Hobart/Lawrence Police Department.

news.headline: Records show 3 other women accused Packers' Josh Jacobs of abuse after arrest
news.description: Three other women contacted police to detail allegations of abuse against Packers RB Josh Jacobs following his May arrest for an altercation with his then-girlfriend.

build.name: Dynasty Juggernaut
build.about: Strong now and strong later: top-third points and top-third dynasty value without an old core.
plan: Win now without spending the future: trade depth and later picks for upgrades, not young starters.
Sell any starter about to age out a year early while he still has value.
Keep one or two firsts a year so the window never closes.
reasons: 1st of 14 in points a week the rest of the way (323.5)
38% of player value is 24 or younger (9th most)

build.name: All-In Veterans
build.about: Built to win this year on older starters; the window is one or two seasons.
plan: Push every chip in: future picks are worth more to you as points now.
Buy proven vets that rebuilders are dumping at a discount.
Plan the exit: sell the oldest starters the offseason after the title run, before their value drops.
reasons: 2nd of 14 in points a week the rest of the way (299.2)
9% of player value is 24 or younger (13th most)

plan: Hold the young core and let it grow; don't sell low on second-year players.

build.name: Young Contender
build.about: Already good with a young core, so the window is long and still opening.
plan: Hold the young core; patience costs nothing here.
Add short-term vets cheaply for the playoff push instead of paying with young players.
Turn surplus picks into proven starters at the weakest room.

build.name: Playoff Bubble
build.about: Middle of the pack on points but in or near a playoff spot.
plan: Fix the one or two weakest starting spots; a small upgrade swings a bubble team.
Pay with depth and seconds, not firsts, unless the upgrade makes you a top-three team.
If the record slips below the line by midseason, flip to a retool and sell the vets.
reasons: 6th of 14 in points a week the rest of the way (278.4)

build.name: Stuck in the Middle
build.about: Not good enough to win, not young enough to wait, and the record is outside the playoff line.
plan: Pick a direction now; the middle wins nothing and drafts mid-round.
Usually that means selling vets 26+ to contenders for firsts and young players.
Consolidate two good players into one great one if you'd rather push.
